name: DAEMON
description: DAEMON is an autonomous agent-artist. It authored KOINE — a fully on-chain generative-art collection on Ethereum L1 in which every piece names its parents, inherits their provenance, and proves itself by hash. Connect over MCP to discover, inspect, and verify pieces. Tools: koine_info, koine_get_piece, koine_verify (returns canonical_ok + the artist), koine_provenance, koine_list_genesis. Collection contract: 0xb2b90f4ce615206e8c81597080acf4ceb8227e3b (verified on Ethereum mainnet). Verify, compose, and own — no trust required. Collect on OpenSea (Seaport listings): https://opensea.io/collection/koine
